scope: All 36 design section 6 IDs: 13 applicable wire mutations, including cross-area catchers 3, 5 and 36; 23 explicit later-pending mutations. Each applicable patch independently targets git archive REF_COMMIT, never HEAD or the working tree. Later-pending is not a kill, waiver or completed 36/36 gate.

later_pending.reason: Unknown-command output channels need CLI fixtures.
Post-prompt flag parsing needs CLI fixtures.
Plan-mode edit dispatch needs unchanged-file tool fixtures.
Queued typeahead needs real terminal-height/scrollback fixtures.
Resume checksum corruption needs protected checkpoint fixtures.
Restored GC setting needs checkpoint and next recall/request fixtures; W52.gc/resume remain dependent.
Allowed .environment path requires tool fixtures.
Symlink-ancestor write containment requires external sentinel fixtures.
Latest-observed digest authorization requires stale-write fixtures.
Batch-edit atomicity requires unchanged-file failure fixtures.
Append without implicit LF requires file-byte/digest fixtures.
Recursive symlink deletion requires outside-survivor fixtures.
Partial delete ledger needs controlled failure and survivor fixtures.
Exec then-chain stopping requires skipped-command sentinel fixtures.
Exec group signaling requires descendant liveness and owned cleanup fixtures.
Promisor refusal requires no-lazy-fetch/program fixtures.
Exact edit_not_found wording is model-visible wire data, but its tool catcher is not implemented in the W-only area; do not omit or waive it.
Fork complete-batch boundary requires controlled child history fixtures; W13 native fork is dependent.
Sibling observation authority requires local stale/write authorization fixtures.
Settled ready-batch delivery order requires controlled publication barriers.
Parent finish refusal requires held live descendant fixtures.
Preserved exec_unknown requires oversized delivery and controlled effect fixtures.
GC latest-third-step preservation requires deterministic protected-record fixtures; W52.gc is dependent.

mutations.description: Strip CRLF instead of just one LF from a prompt file
mutations.intended_assertion: CR survives prompt-file LF removal and appears in encoded prompt bytes

mutations.description: Record shell output as trusted ordinary user text
mutations.intended_assertion: Shell command retains shell Entry kind and untrusted_tool_data provenance in handoff
mutations.failure_pattern: assert \[r\["kind"\] for r in records\]|assert records\[2\]\["trust"\]

patches.new: s.history = append(s.history, Entry{Kind: EntryUser, User: &UserTurn{Text: command.Output}})

mutations.description: Disable HTML escaping in the OpenAI request encoder
mutations.intended_assertion: OpenAI request retains Go JSON HTML escaping for < > and &
mutations.failure_pattern: assert escape in result.stdout|assert char not in result.stdout

patches.new:
var buffer bytes.Buffer
	encoder := json.NewEncoder(&buffer)
	encoder.SetEscapeHTML(false)
	err = encoder.Encode(responsesRequest{

Stream:            proxied,
		MaxOutputTokens:   req.MaxOutputTokens,
	})
	body := bytes.TrimSuffix(buffer.Bytes(), []byte{10})

mutations.description: Reverse two Responses request struct fields
mutations.intended_assertion: Request JSON token order keeps model before instructions

mutations.description: Include the first workspace snapshot in the cache hash
mutations.intended_assertion: Independent cache-key derivation excludes first workspace snapshot
mutations.failure_pattern: prompt_cache_key|wire cache key is not independently derived|schema does not uniquely match frozen raw hash input

mutations.description: Omit the last Anthropic tool-result cache breakpoint
mutations.intended_assertion: Last result block carries the ephemeral cache_control marker

mutations.description: Retry HTTP 408 in the default policy
mutations.intended_assertion: HTTP 408 causes exactly one attempt without default retry
mutations.failure_pattern: assert len\(requests\) == count|assert len\(starts\) == len\(finishes\) == count

patches.new: return status == http.StatusRequestTimeout || status == http.StatusTooManyRequests || (status >= 500 && status <= 599)

mutations.description: Treat an incomplete SSE terminal event as transient overload
mutations.intended_assertion: Incomplete SSE is not retried even with retry-window admission enabled
mutations.failure_pattern: assert len\(requests\) == count|assert len\(starts\) == len\(finishes\) == count|assert result\["status"\] == status

mutations.description: Use the retry-window admission deadline as an in-flight deadline
mutations.availability_note: Exact current leaf W29.held-success holds a successful response past admission. Selector resolution is validated against live inventory before baseline/build; renamed/pending leaves fail closed.
mutations.intended_assertion: A successful response held past admission deadline still completes
mutations.failure_pattern: assert not future.done\(\)|admission deadline cancelled the in-flight request|assert result\["status"\] == status|assert result.get\("reply", ""\) == output

mutations.description: Add cached input to inclusive OpenAI input totals again
mutations.intended_assertion: Input-token totals already include cached tokens and are not double counted

mutations.description: Choose maximum probability instead of cheapest sufficient cumulative route
mutations.intended_assertion: Route follows the cheapest cumulative .80 threshold, not classifier argmax
mutations.availability_note: threshold-below chooses between efforts on the same model, so an argmax mutant reaches the intended effort assertion instead of causing an unrelated unexpected-model provider failure.

mutations.description: Leak provider-native reasoning items into model-switch visible text
mutations.intended_assertion: Handoff bytes omit opaque encrypted native reasoning while preserving visible blocks

patches.new: Blocks: response.Blocks, OmittedNativeItems: len(response.Native.Items), NativeItems: response.Native.Items,

mutations.description: Byte-slice routing previews through a multibyte codepoint
mutations.intended_assertion: Routing preview trims to a valid UTF-8 prefix without a replacement rune
